ns2:course.label: Counseling Psychology Practicum
ns2:course.description: Intensive supervised experiences in applied educational psychology; use of a wide variety of diagnostic and observational techniques and treatment. Students may take more than one section. Approved for letter and S/U grading. Prerequisite: Master's degree in educational psychology or equivalent; consent of instructor.
